info.name: POS & Payment — A-08 supplement
info.description: Default runner performs read/auth tests; mutation folder skipped unless explicitly enabled. Existing collection remains separate.

exec: const u=pm.variables.replaceIn('{{baseUrl}}');if(!new RegExp('^http://(localhost|127[.]0[.]0[.]1):[0-9]+$').test(u))throw new Error('Use localhost with explicit port');

pm.test('JWT and role', () => { const d=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.role).to.eql('RECEPTIONIST'); pm.expect(d.token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.collectionVariables.set('posToken',d.token); });

pm.test('JWT and role', () => { const d=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.role).to.eql('KITCHEN'); pm.expect(d.token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.collectionVariables.set('kitchenToken',d.token); });
